msg: Hi! We're 10 friends from Amsterdam: 6 certified divers (2 are Advanced) and 4 who just want to snorkel. Departing from Cartagena. Group discount? Prices?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

That sounds like a fantastic group trip to the Rosario Islands! It must be requested from the team before paying. The discount does not apply to PADI courses, so the Advanced divers’ fun dives are eligible, but an Advanced course would not be.

For the certified divers, the listed option is Fun Dives — 2 dives in one day. For the snorkelers, it’s the Snorkeling Tour. I’m leaving the per-person prices below in USD and COP; the price is the same, only the currency changes.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• Snorkeling Tour: 126 USD · 140 USD (448.000 COP · 497.000 COP)
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 178 USD · 197 USD (630.000 COP · 700.000 COP)
• 3-dive package (1 day, 2 daytime + 1 night dive): 287 USD · 319 USD (1.017.000 COP · 1.130.000 COP)
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 316 USD · 351 USD (1.154.000 COP · 1.282.000 COP)
• PADI Advanced Course: 616 USD · 685 USD (2.175.000 COP · 2.417.000 COP)

The group discount (10% from 5 people) does not apply to PADI courses, so this course doesn't have it.

I recommend the *2 dives in 1 day* plan in the Rosario Islands. (If you'd rather do more dives, there are *packages* of 3 or more; just tell me.)

Has it been *more than 2 years* since any diver in the group last dived?

msg: Nobody wants a course: 2 of us already HAVE the Advanced certification. Everyone dived this year. We're all Dutch, leaving from Cartagena next Saturday. 6 do the 2 dives and 4 snorkel. How do we book and get the group discount?
reply:
Got it—no courses, and the two Advanced certifications are for fun dives. Since everyone dived this year, the refresher isn’t needed.

For your group, book the 6 Fun Dives spots and 4 Snorkeling Tour spots using these links:
- Fun Dives — 2 dives: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/salidas-de-buceo/1?language=en
- Snorkeling Tour: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/superficio/3?language=en

As international guests, you pay in USD. The online booking discount is 10%. Your group also qualifies for the 10% group discount, which stacks with the online discount for 20% total when booking online. The group discount is not applied automatically: contact the team to request it *before paying*. If you pay before requesting it, it can’t be refunded afterward. Book and pay through the links; the website takes payment by card.

There is always availability: we operate every day, including public holidays, except December 25 and January 1; if sea conditions are not safe, the trip is rescheduled.

Just to confirm, should I change it?
• 6 certified diving, 4 snorkeling, 2 the Advanced course → *6 certified diving, 4 snorkeling*
• 12 people → *10 people*

msg: Yes: 10 people, 6 dive and 4 snorkel. Who do we contact to request the group discount before paying?
reply:
The 10% group discount applies to groups of 5 or more and stacks with the 10% online discount, for 20% total when booking online. It isn’t applied automatically: the group must request it from the team before paying. It applies to recreational diving and snorkeling. The online discount is applied automatically when booking directly through our website.

I don't hand out phone numbers here 🔒, but I'm passing you to a Diving Planet advisor so they can talk to you directly. They'll get in touch shortly. Thanks! 🙌
